source_evidence: Exact player 'Then can I introduce you to our neighbors? And assure them of your protection and let them know you are capable of coexistance?' asks both cooperating warders whether they consent to introduction to living neighbors and demonstration of willingness to coexist. Both voluntarily agree, identify themselves: first receiving warder Rhevan, second lower warder Ossric (new names delivered in play, no new creatures, powers or backstory). Ossric recognizes their appearance may frighten residents and prefers not to approach cottage unannounced. Both agree to leave their existing two skeletal sentries each at their posts, meet Hessa without weapons drawn, and honor their previous commitment to protect rather than confine or harm peaceful living people. Cirren recommends allowing Hessa to choose whether/where she meets them and letting conduct demonstrate trust; warders agree to wait in shade at entrance if invited. No actual encounter with Hessa, assurance by V beyond stated request, resident assent, movement, magic, attack, legal approval, verified safety, complete clearance or title yet. No check for willing consent to a proposal consistent with accepted duties. Day331~16:42, V chooses how to introduce them.
